name: Scarlet Base Camp
summary: Scarlet Base Camp is a fortified outpost on the eastern shore of Lake Mereldar in the Eastern Plaguelands, just west of Tyr's Hand. Its barricades mark an outer defensive position of the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: A Forward Line on Lake Mereldar
sections.body: Perched on the eastern bank of Lake Mereldar, Scarlet Base Camp is a barricaded fortification just west of Tyr's Hand. It marks an outer position of the Scarlet Crusade in the blighted countryside.

sections.title: Shielding the Bastion
sections.body: Tyr's Hand is one of the Scarlet Crusade's strongholds in Lordaeron. The camp lies along its western approaches, in a region where the Crusade seeks to reclaim the land from the undead and treats outsiders with suspicion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Scarlet Base Camp?
faq.answer: The camp is a barricaded Scarlet Crusade fortification on the eastern bank of Lake Mereldar, just west of Tyr's Hand.

faq.q: Who leads the forces stationed at the camp?
faq.answer: No commander is identified for the original Classic camp. It is a Scarlet Crusade position near Tyr's Hand.

faq.q: Are the occupants hostile to travelers?
aliases: will scarlet base camp attack me
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is hostile to outsiders of both factions, regarding them as potential carriers of the plague or agents of the Scourge.

faq.q: Where is the camp in relation to Lake Mereldar?
faq.answer: It stands on Lake Mereldar's eastern bank, just west of Tyr's Hand.

angles.text: The camp reflects the tragic corruption of the Silver Hand's legacy, where righteous zeal in the defense of Lordaeron's holy ground has warped into aggressive paranoia against fellow survivors.
The outpost serves as a direct reminder of the living zealots who wish to purge the Forsaken from Lordaeron just as ruthlessly as they hunt the mindless Scourge.
